Retain the warm tuning indicator at about 83% of full canvas width. Place skyline around 72% of full canvas height with low water reflections below. No invented store signs, frequencies or lore. Continuous edge-to-edge art, not an image placed inside a card, no black bars, framing, guides, watermark or YouTube UI. Output ONE complete 16:9 upload artwork.
